author: /root/edge_paths
scope: Manual semantic consolidation of complete French authored cases.
principle: Paraphrases and changes limited to fabric, item type, decorative treatment or incidental setting share a concept. Distinct construction mechanisms and distinct garment uses remain separate when those differences carry the scenario.

prior_labels: Dress hem clipped for shoe comparison
Coat length checked on stairs
merges.reason: Both sets check whether the temporary garment length clears footwear or movement; the garment type and fitting location vary.

prior_labels: Knit facing folded outward
Vest lining extended as lower band
merges.reason: Both make a normally inner border visible as an outer band. Different fabric and edge positions share the reveal motif.

prior_labels: Sleeve lining pinned before stitching
Coat sleeve lined with striped offcut
merges.reason: Basting and replacing a worn sleeve lining belong to the same sleeve-relining scenario.

prior_labels: Lined rain hood dried inside out
Fine glove lining pulled free for drying
merges.reason: Both separate the lining from its shell to dry; hood versus glove is an item substitution.

prior_labels: Open knit blocked on rounded form
Knit sleeve washed on removable form
merges.reason: Both maintain a curved knit shape on a padded form during drying.

prior_labels: Hat folded along travel crease
Hat brim reinforced with removable wire
merges.reason: Both prepare a hat to be packed flat; fold line and removable wire are variants within that scenario.

prior_labels: Cardigan sleeve repaired with matching knit tube
Dress sleeves lengthened by cuff band
merges.reason: Both add a new section to extend the sleeve; knit versus woven fabric does not create a new motif.

merges.concept: Shirt closure strip reused as wearable band
merges.english_gloss: Shirt closure strip reused as wearable band
prior_labels: Shirt cuff converted into hair band
Bracelet made from shirt placket
merges.reason: Both preserve a shirt button-and-hole strip as a new soft wearable band.

prior_labels: Wrist watch over long glove
Ring moved outside fingerless mitt
merges.reason: Both position jewelry outside hand-covering fabric; changing jewelry or glove style is consolidated.

prior_labels: Long sleeve gathered under bracelet
Shirt cuffs folded under watch strap
merges.reason: The wrist accessory holds the sleeve edge in position in both sets.

prior_labels: Small scarf protecting necklace clasp
Folded scarf used as waist padding
merges.reason: Both place a soft folded textile between a hard fastening and another surface.

prior_labels: Neckline secured with soft backing
Beaded hair slide padded underneath
merges.reason: Both cover the reverse of beadwork with smooth backing to prevent snagging.

prior_labels: Pearl buttons replaced by fabric loops
Dress waist secured with elastic button loop
merges.reason: Both use enlarged soft loops at a garment fastening; material and location variants are consolidated.

prior_labels: Pocket held shut by invisible snap
Loose shirt secured with underarm snaps
merges.reason: Both add hidden snap fasteners to keep an opening from gaping.

prior_labels: Scarf ends linked by small carabiner
Scarf clasp placed off shoulder seam
merges.reason: Both use a small hardware fastening to retain the scarf; placement and clasp shape vary.

merges.concept: Bag pocket arranged for easy reach
merges.english_gloss: Bag pocket arranged for easy reach
prior_labels: Bag pocket angled for seated reach
Zipped pocket opening away from elbow
merges.reason: Both reorient the bag pocket toward the reaching hand; sitting is incidental.

prior_labels: Knot balancing deep neckline
Collar tips joined with soft ribbon
merges.reason: Both use a textile tie between the sides of the neckline opening.

prior_labels: Coat collar softened by steaming
Soft lapel stretched on curved cushion
merges.reason: Both restore the soft roll of a collar or lapel with shaping and steam.
